quest.title: Serenity's Reprise
quest.description: Tlazolli awaits her punishment, Nepecha has regained her "name," and the Blazegem Inscriptions are about to be destroyed. The nightmare and entrapment have both dissipated, and it is all over. Xilonen has also brought Nepecha to her own workshop. Perhaps she still has something in mind...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x60, Mora x17050, Guide to Kindling x5, Adventurer's Experience x8, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks: Act III
chapter.title: Melodious Chant

talks.objective: Visit Xilonen's workshop again the next day
Head to Xilonen's workshop for a visit

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. Everything's been taken care of now. I was just about to go have a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what about Tlazolli? Will she be punished?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Well, the tribe is still discussing that. I mean, not many have ever used Ancient Names to commit a crime... Pacal will have a lot on his plate.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: What I do know is that Tlazolli's workshop will be closed permanently, and any remaining incomplete Blazegem Inscriptions will be completely destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: As for the completed Blazegem Inscriptions, I'll be handling them, which, yeah, yet another hassle to deal with...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Anyway, at least her Ancient Name is fine, otherwise, we'd have a real mess on our hands...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Oh, and speaking of Ancient Names, I actually have some good news. The memories that were absorbed by the Blazegem Inscriptions can be restored to their owners.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Once all the Blazegem Inscriptions stop working, the memories will return to their respective owners.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Yeah, that's right. Huh, wait, now that I think about it... In her attempt to get Nechca to come back, Auntie made the entire tribe forget about her.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Now, Nechca really is gone, but everyone is about to remember her... What a bizarre turn of events.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: She's resting in my workshop. I contacted others from the tribe, and told them about my plan to conduct an official investigation into her history.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: The tribe hasn't responded yet, so I'm planning to take her in for now, and teach her some crafting skills.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: But that's for another time. For now, she should just rest and sleep.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: After all, she's got a busy future ahead of her.
